name: George Washington Carver Museum, Cultural and Genealogy Center
hours_summary: Tue–Thu · 10 AM – 9 PM · Fri 10 AM – 5:30 PM · Sat 10 AM – 4 PM · closed Sun–Mon
best_for: Visitors wanting East Austin's Black history
tagline: Austin's African American history museum, in a Juneteenth-era East Austin neighborhood.
description: A City of Austin museum documenting African American history, art, and culture in Austin and Texas. Permanent galleries cover the Juneteenth story, Black Austin from Reconstruction forward, and a genealogy center for family-history research, with rotating contemporary art shows in the Artist Workspace.

tips.text: Always free — run by the City of Austin.
Weekday evenings until 9 PM are unusual for a museum — the quietest time to visit.

highlights.item: Primary documents from Austin's Juneteenth celebrations

distance_landmark: In East Austin, 1 mi east of downtown
